title: rosa canina subvar. mucronulata
intro: Rosa canina subvar. mucronulata, commonly known as the Dwarf Dog Rose, is a species of rose native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as digestive issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina subvar. mucronulata include anti-hemorrhagic, anti-inflammatory, and vulnerary effects, which help to stop bleeding, reduce swelling, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
